gold.taskTitle: Get a tetanus booster shot this month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to receive a tetanus booster shot within the current month.

questions.title: When did you last receive a tetanus shot?
questions.description: Understanding the date of the last tetanus shot helps determine urgency and eligibility for a booster.

questions.title: Do you have a primary care doctor or clinic?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has an existing provider helps identify where they can get the shot most easily.

questions.title: Does your insurance cover vaccine visits?
questions.description: Insurance coverage affects which locations are practical and whether cost is a concern.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline within this month?
questions.description: A hard deadline, such as before travel or a procedure, affects how quickly appointments must be scheduled.

questions.title: Are you open to walk-in options like pharmacies?
questions.description: Some users prefer scheduled appointments; others are open to walk-in clinics or pharmacy vaccine services.

questions.title: What city or area are you located in?
questions.description: Location is needed to identify nearby clinics, pharmacies, or health departments that offer tetanus shots.

questions.title: Do you have any allergies or recent vaccine reactions?
questions.description: Known allergies or prior reactions to vaccines are important for safe scheduling and provider communication.
